title: Linked devices
summary: Settings > Sua conta > Aparelhos conectados (ADR 0116): the other devices of the account with their last use, a sign-out per device, and the only entry to Conectar um computador.

name.description: The device display name. Absent shows bipe_linked_devices_unknown_name.

phase.description: failed shows bipe_linked_devices_error with a retry.

devices.description: Every device of the account except this phone (Client.deviceId), newest use first. Empty shows bipe_linked_devices_empty.

canLinkComputer.description: The server advertises org.matrix.msc4108 and this phone holds the hidden password of a device-first account (ADR 0118 support gate).

confirmingSignOut.description: The device the sign-out dialog asks about.

load.effect: GET /_matrix/client/v3/devices with the access token (the SDK has no device list in the bindings), and GET /_matrix/client/versions for the support gate.

linkComputer.effect: Opens link-computer (bipe-chat/bipe#573). Without the support gate shows bipe_link_computer_not_supported; an account without a PIN gets bipe_link_computer_needs_pin and bipe_link_computer_create_pin.

askSignOut.effect: Opens the dialog bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_title with bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_body.

signOut.effect: Device owner check (bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_biometric), then opens the MAS account page that ends that device's session (Client.accountUrl with AccountManagementAction DeviceDelete, else the MSC4191 org.matrix.session_end action) in the private web view of link-computer, fills the MAS login once with the hidden password, and reloads the list when the page reports done.

notes: A web device is unattested (ADR 0043): no badge, Pix or business account from the web. The list does not say so; the web shows it.
bipe_linked_devices_last_used takes the date from the system formatter.

Bipe logic: BipeMatrixAccountAPI.devices, supportsQRLogin and authMetadata, BipeWebLink.sessionEndURL, BipeMatrixDevice (iOS BipeWebLink.swift); BipeMatrixAccountApi, BipeLinkedDevicesPresenter, BipeWebApprovalController (Android weblink/). Move them.
Entrar em outro aparelho (QR from this phone to a new phone, bipe-chat/bipe#203) is not part of phase 1; its row stays out until #203 ships.
